summary: New Pacific Metals Corp, a Canadian gold-silver explorer listed on the NYSE and TSX, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Meeting and Record Date. The annual general meeting is set for November 27, 2026 in Vancouver, BC, with a record date of October 23, 2026 for notice, voting and beneficial ownership determination. Computershare acts as transfer agent; the notice was addressed to Canadian securities regulators and the NYSE. No special-situation event, transaction, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is routine meeting administration, warranting no deal-terms analysis.
